context: Evaluates correct use of spprof's is_active() and stats() functions. The candidate must check profiler state before/during/after profiling and correctly use the ProfilerStats result object.

checklist.name: is_active() before start
checklist.description: Calls spprof.is_active() before start() and confirms it returns False.

checklist.name: is_active() after start
checklist.description: Calls spprof.is_active() after start() and confirms it returns True.

checklist.name: stats() returns None when inactive
checklist.description: Calls spprof.stats() before start() and confirms it returns None.

checklist.name: stats() returns ProfilerStats when active
checklist.description: Calls spprof.stats() during profiling and verifies the result is not None and has a numeric collected_samples field.

checklist.name: is_active() after stop
checklist.description: Calls spprof.is_active() after stop() and confirms it returns False.
